- **A batch in the group (ADR-0094 B9).** A door forwards a batch whole: the followers read both rows with one version; a replay by `id` goes through a voter and through a door; a stale `cas` of a row means the others are not written. The door's own row by a batch — 403 (N1.3 `door`). After `@sigkill` of the leader the new leader gives both rows (judge-only: sc. 31; checks P/01.3-R006, P/01.1-R135).
- **Size and the door without a vote.** A join beyond the declared size — 409 `refused` both without `force` and with `force` (`-force` does not take beyond the declared size; N1.3 `join`). A door (`-door -voters`): `state` `Door`, a write through it — by the same rights file (forwarding to the leader, visible at a follower), the row `platform/configstore-doors/<id>` with a fresh `seen_at`, the metrics row `configstore_doors` at the leader. A door whose `-id` is not the server of its leaf — a start refusal. The leaf of a door writes at the leader a foreign row of the family `platform/configstore-doors/` — 403, its own — 200 (N1.3 `door` «own»); the role forwarding header in a probe is a designation, the name is from the implementation description (judge-only: sc. 07, 26; checks P/01.3-R006, P/01.3-R016).
- **Membership, restart, leader change, quorum.** A size outside `sizes` of N1.3 — a start refusal; `leave` of a stopped member, its `join` before `admit` — 403, `admit` is repeatable (code 0), after it `join` with the same address — 200, with another Raft address — 409, `leave` of an unknown member — 409 (N1.3 `leave`, `repeat`); a restarted member is a follower again. After a restart of a follower and of the whole group the versions are the same at all members, and a write with `cas` of that version passes (the log is not applied again). After a leader change a read at the remaining members sees the version of a write, a returned member too (the read is linearizable, P/01.1 N3). A write through a door and through a voter without a quorum — 503 `unavailable` after the effective `-leader-wait` interval: the door is not part of the quorum (judge-only: sc. 17; checks P/01.3-R006, P/01.1-R062).
- **`import` into a group and `recover`.** `import` of a copy into a fresh group at the leader; a repeat of a completed one — a refusal (N1.3 `admin_ops`). The transferred rows keep the versions of the copy, and `cas` by them passes (P/01.3 N1.3 `import`, N3 «the copy is replayed into exactly those rows and versions»): an implementation that rewrites the transfer by ordinary `put` with new small versions fails here. That the new versions after the transfer are above `-index-base`, the scenario does not judge by numbers (the strings are compared only by `==`/`!=`) — by reading. With the majority lost, `recover` without `-isolated` and with `-upper` below the computed one — a refusal before any changes; with `-isolated` — the floor by the upper of the epoch rows, the rows and the epochs are kept (upper is from all epoch rows). The former members with old directories do not return (N3 step 0); new members join from empty directories (`-force` at a transitional parity); the floor is visible at a new follower (judge-only: sc. 18; checks P/01.3-R006, P/01.3-R018, P/01.3-R020, P/01.3-R021, P/01.3-R022, P/01.3-R021, P/01.3-R021, P/01.3-R021, P/01.3-R021, P/01.3-R021, P/01.3-R022).

- **Forwarding, metrics and a cut raft port**: the leaf of a voter with the role forwarding header `admin` at the leader with a loaded rights file — 403 (P/01.2 N3); the `/metrics` rows of the leader and of a follower (the names of N1.3 `metrics`, the state in lowercase per ADR-0070); a proxy on the raft port of a member cuts incoming connections (the outgoing connections of the member go directly): after a write a read at the cut member — the new version or 503, not the earlier one, after `@mend` — the new one (the steps do not assume who the leader is) (judge-only: sc. 07, 17; checks P/01.2-R025, P/01.3-R006, P/01.3-R032, P/01.1-R062).
- **Door status, door rows, import and recover edges**: `/v1/status` of a door whole by N2: `Door`, `role` `door`, `term`, `commit`, `applied` — 0; the leaf of a door at the leader: its own row with `cas: ""`, with an extra element and its deletion — 403, its own row by the form — 200 (N1.3 `door`: only `put` without `cas` and `guard`, the single `seen_at`); a live door has written its row: `import` of a copy with `-index-base` below the versions of the copy — a refusal, no rows; with `-index-base` not below them — transferred, the version of the copy is kept (a door row does not cancel freshness); with the majority lost `recover -peers` without its own member, without an `api` address, with a repeat of a member — a refusal; a `-upper` above the computed one raises the floor; `import` of a copy with a future `generation_at` of the floor without `-force` — a refusal, nothing is transferred, with `-force` — transferred, the floor is raised (N1.3 `floor` `when`, «Daemon flags» `-force`) (judge-only: sc. 25–29; checks P/01.3-R006, P/01.3-R007, P/01.3-R016, P/01.3-R020, P/01.3-R021).
- **A lost answer of a forwarded write (sc. 32–34)**: `@cut store@s1 answer` at the leader `s1`, then a write. The leader executes and commits it, its answer does not reach the caller. A door with `id` (sc. 32), a follower with `id` (sc. 33) and a door without `id` (sc. 34) answer 503 `ambiguous`, not `unavailable`: the write went to the leader without an answer. removed: Functional scenarios, compilation and an engineering Raft group run do not establish production qualification. Each applicable group below requires independent observations on the same identified candidate under a declared, agreed workload/resource envelope. Missing input, finite budget or qualified binding is blocked/NotExecuted for the dependent group; inactive fault/latch injection is an instrumentation error. A timeout of the judge, forced kill, producer counter, EIO text or library return is not PASS. No candidate execution is claimed by publishing this document.

source: P01.294; ADR-0130 Addendum (20) item 1; Architect answer 2026-11-12T22:03:33Z
removed: Before measurement record exact Source/implementation/runner/profile/artifact/fixture/library/compiler identities, invocation and durability mode. Declare workload cardinalities, operation rate/mix, key/item/body sizes, replay locality, checkpoint policy, concurrency and input bytes; record CPU, RAM, storage/filesystem/mount/cache facts relevant to the experiment. The [first approved budgets](#first-approved-budgets) apply to the envelope named there. Cache/eligible-GC, output and cancellation budgets are not approved yet. Each of them, like the budgets of P/01.3 R035 and R036, is a finite positive budget declared by the implementation, and the probe of a dependent case receives its value as input from the environment (ADR-0130 Addendum (5) item 3). The implementation declares the value; the threshold of production acceptance is approved as in ADR-0130 Addendum (9), and a claim of the candidate alone is not enough (ADR-0130 Addendum (15) item 7). The stop budget fits below the actual manager stop deadline with measured teardown margin. Calibrate monotonic resolution/scheduling uncertainty separately; it does not increase a protocol budget. Candidate assertions alone do not qualify these inputs. Unknown values stay unknown, not invented universal defaults.

source: P01.294; ADR-0130 Addendum (20) item 1; Architect answer 2026-11-12T22:03:33Z
removed: The R141 minimum is strictly more than ID_REPLAY_MIN_AGE AND at least ID_REPLAY_MIN_RECORDS later applied identifier records, owned by [runtime-constants.tsv](../forms/runtime-constants.tsv); it is not a RAM/id upper bound. Test the two edges independently with distinct successful later applications; do not invent a counting rule from unadmitted requests, admitted refusals or replays. The age runs from the first application on the admission-time clock (R141). GC is finite only under the qualified workload/budget. Logical reclaim is not immediate physical file shrink.

source: P01.294; ADR-0130 Addendum (20) item 1; Architect answer 2026-11-12T22:03:33Z
removed: A node is addressed by its stable daemon `-id` in the topology of the case (P/01.3 N1.3). Leader and follower are observed changing roles (`leader_id` of `/v1/status`), not addresses. One `clock` provider controls the explicitly listed consuming wall-clock domains of the case, each named by the `-id` of its node; a domain that is not listed is not controlled. The independent monotonic baseline of the observer is not shifted. Offsets use the seconds of the wall stamps of the chapter, and no skew allowance is added.

source: P01.294; ADR-0130 Addendum (20) item 1; Architect answer 2026-11-12T22:03:33Z
removed: The checks of P/01.1 R013 are the actual spread between the clocks beyond `CLOCK_SKEW`, a common shift and return, and the non-decrease of admission time. The probes also need a leader change, a Raft snapshot, the equality of admission time, and a replay held after `not_after` before the first application. Writer and client clocks belong to the scope only when the selected workload actually uses them; live P/03, P/04 or new N−1 stands are not assumed. Until the public case payload and a qualified provider exist, a dependent check stays `MissingBinding`/`NOTEXEC`.

removed: Separate actual protocol output/state/replay from test-only instrumentation. Complete recoverable bytes must be proved before judging the R144 ambiguous_barrier branch. Compare whole batch/id state, and admission metadata separately. An absent binding is not proof that an implementation is wrong or successful.

source: P01.294; ADR-0130 Addendum (20) item 1; Architect answer 2026-11-12T22:03:33Z
removed: Record raw input/output/status/signal/timeout, monotonic phase and activation order, full case/identity inventory including failures, resource cleanup and reopen observations. Report normative mismatch, instrumentation error, blocked/NotExecuted and successful measured scope separately; no silent skip or weaker expected result. Raw-copy controls include correct ordinary-role GET403 before snapshot, unsupported-method 405/Allow GET and bodyless HEAD, complete CL/chunked, missing first body byte, missing terminal chunk, short CL, after 200 no second fault, and preservation of the previous published file. These are controlled fixtures and future candidate obligations, not an executed SUT or a new private platform protocol.

source: P01.294; ADR-0130 Addendum (20) item 1; Architect answer 2026-11-12T22:03:33Z; derived Russian translation
removed: До измерения записать точные Source/implementation/runner/profile/artifact/fixture/library/compiler, вызов и режим долговечности. Объявить число строк нагрузки, частоту/смесь операций, размеры key/items/body, локальность повторов, checkpoint, параллельность и входные байты; записать относящиеся к опыту CPU, RAM, storage/filesystem/mount/cache. [Первые утверждённые бюджеты](#первые-утверждённые-бюджеты) действуют для названной там области. Бюджеты кеша/допустимой сборки, вывода и отмены ещё не утверждены. Каждый из них, как и бюджеты P/01.3 R035 и R036, — конечный положительный бюджет, объявленный реализацией, а проба зависимого случая получает его значение входом от среды (ADR-0130 Addendum (5) п. 3). Значение объявляет реализация; порог боевой приёмки утверждается как в ADR-0130 Addendum (9), одного заявления кандидата мало (ADR-0130 Addendum (15) п. 7). Бюджет остановки ниже фактического срока менеджера с измеренным запасом завершения. Разрешение монотонных часов/планировщик калибруются отдельно и не увеличивают срок протокола. Одних утверждений кандидата недостаточно. Неизвестные значения не становятся выдуманными универсальными умолчаниями.

source: P01.294; ADR-0130 Addendum (20) item 1; Architect answer 2026-11-12T22:03:33Z; derived Russian translation
removed: Узел адресуется своим постоянным `-id` демона в топологии случая (P/01.3 N1.3). Лидер и ведомый — наблюдаемые меняющиеся роли (`leader_id` в `/v1/status`), а не адреса. Один провайдер `clock` управляет явно перечисленными потребляющими доменами стенных часов случая, каждый назван `-id` своего узла; неперечисленный домен не управляется. Независимая монотонная база наблюдателя не сдвигается. Сдвиги — в секундах меток времени главы; допуск на разброс не добавляется.

source: P01.294; ADR-0130 Addendum (20) item 1; Architect answer 2026-11-12T22:03:33Z; derived Russian translation
removed: Проверки P/01.1 R013 — фактический разброс между часами сверх `CLOCK_SKEW`, общий сдвиг и возврат, неубывание времени приёма. Пробам нужны также смена лидера, снимок Raft, равенство времени приёма и удержанный повтор после `not_after` до первого применения. Часы писателя и клиента входят в область, только если их действительно использует выбранная нагрузка; живые стенды P/03, P/04 или новые N−1 не предполагаются. Пока нет публичной нагрузки случая и квалифицированного провайдера, зависимая проверка остаётся `MissingBinding`/`NOTEXEC`.

source: P01.294; ADR-0130 Addendum (20) item 1; Architect answer 2026-11-12T22:03:33Z; derived Russian translation
removed: Отделять фактические протокол/state/replay от тестовых привязок. Каждую storage/clock/progress/fault-привязку квалифицировать независимо квитанциями активированной стадии и отрицательными контролями; обычный restart или SIGKILL не доказывает физическую долговечность. Полные восстанавливаемые байты доказываются до оценки ambiguous_barrier R144. Состояние пакета/id сравнивается целиком, admission-метаданные отдельно. Отсутствующая привязка не доказывает ни дефект, ни успех реализации.

source: P01.294; ADR-0130 Addendum (20) item 1; Architect answer 2026-11-12T22:03:33Z; derived Russian translation
removed: Записать сырые input/output/status/signal/timeout, монотонные фазы и порядок активации, полную опись случаев/идентичностей вместе с отказами, очистку ресурсов и reopen. Разделять нарушение нормы, ошибку инструмента, blocked/NotExecuted и успешную измеренную область; без молчаливого skip или ослабления ожидания. Сырые copy-контроли включают корректный GET обычной роли403 до снимка, неподдерживаемый метод 405/Allow GET и HEAD без тела, полный CL/chunked, отсутствие первого байта тела, отсутствие финальной части, короткий CL, отсутствие второго отказа после 200 и сохранение прежнего файла. Это контролируемые fixtures и обязанности будущего кандидата, не исполненный SUT или новый частный протокол платформы.

removed: The input is [`soak.json`](../forms/production/soak.json), checked against [`soak.schema.json`](../forms/production/soak.schema.json). It is a record of Q, separate from the input of N6.2 and from the functional scenarios of J. Its executor before the qualifier is ready is `court-tools`, `soak/`, revision `6fd588df`; afterwards the same executor is the comparison reference for the qualifier. Record the actual executor commit, invocation and artifact hashes with the result; the record does not supply a candidate pin.

source: P01.345; ADR-0135 addendum (33) item 3
removed: Before scoring a candidate, activate the negative controls of the record through the same executor and history checker. The `lost_log_tail` mutant drops an acknowledged log tail on recovery; a witness not superseded by another write must expose that loss. The `read_without_fence` mutant serves local reads without confirmation through the current leader; after isolation and a completed write in the live group a stale successful read must be detected. Record the mutants' identities, activation receipts and exact history counterexamples. A correct reference history must be accepted. A missed mutant or an inactive fault is an instrument error, red, class `stand`, and yields no candidate verdict. Naming the controls without executing them qualifies nothing.

source: P01.345; ADR-0135 addendum (33) item 3; derived Russian translation
removed: Вход — [`soak.json`](../../forms/production/soak.json), проверяемый по [`soak.schema.json`](../../forms/production/soak.schema.json). source: P01.345; ADR-0135 addendum (33) item 3; derived Russian translation
removed: До оценки кандидата активировать отрицательные контроли записи тем же исполнителем и проверкой истории. Мутант `lost_log_tail` теряет подтверждённый хвост журнала при восстановлении; свидетель, не заменённый другой записью, должен обнаружить потерю. Мутант `read_without_fence` обслуживает локальные чтения без подтверждения через текущего лидера; после изоляции и завершённой записи в живой группе успешное устаревшее чтение должно быть обнаружено. Записать тождества мутантов, квитанции активации и точные контрпримеры истории. Верная эталонная история должна приниматься. Пропущенный мутант или неактивный сбой — ошибка инструмента, red, класс `stand`, без вердикта кандидату. Перечень неисполненных контролей ничего не квалифицирует.

source: P01.345; ADR-0135 addendum (33) item 3
